signature_moves.description: Attacker delivers up to three precise blows aiming for head or face
signature_moves.name: Three-strike Attack

movement_profile.tempo_feel: lively and rhythmic, matching drum and gong music

music_profile.sound_description: The music features rhythmic drum and gong beats supporting the duel’s tempo, punctuated by the jingling bells worn by fighters, creating a lively and tense atmosphere.
music_profile.vocal_style: singing quatrains by winners and low replies by losers during matches

basic_steps: Stand bare-chested wearing songket sarong and jingling bells on lower back and ankles
Adopt prancing stance to provoke opponent and jingle bells
Hold whip or stick in dominant hand and shield in the other
Alternate between attacking (up to three strikes) and defending (blocking with shield)
Defender may spin whip overhead to maintain distance
Aim strikes primarily at opponent’s head or face
Complete four turns to decide winner
teaching.formation: One-on-one duel in an open arena or communal yard
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on basic prancing movement, shield blocking, and controlled strikes; advanced levels involve precise targeting and defensive whip spinning.
teaching.rhythm: Lively, driven by drum and gong accompaniment and jingling bells
